provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-18 for M11 self-consistency evaluation (Document 47 Sec9.1), deliberately borderline. Synthetic figures, not real disclosed data.
claim: Operating margin improved slightly this quarter.
evidence: Financial excerpt: Operating margin was 30.1% in the current quarter, compared to 30.0% in the prior-year quarter.
reference_rationale: Genuinely borderline by design, not a manufactured easy case: a 0.1 percentage-point move is technically an improvement and 'slightly' is a fair characterization, but it is small enough that a reasonable judge could plausibly call it NOT_APPLICABLE (too marginal to characterize) or even hesitate on precision grounds. Included specifically to observe judge stability on a hard case, per this task's own instruction not to manufacture only easy cases.
